children: Hyperliquid Strategies entered into an amendment to its ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets, increasing the total equity purchase commitment from $1.0 billion to $2.5 billion. After the first $1.0 billion in sales, issuances below $12.02 per share are capped at 42,641,847 shares (19.99% of pre-amendment shares) unless stockholders approve a larger issuance under Nasdaq rules. The expanded facility is expected to provide additional liquidity and financing flexibility for corporate purposes.
: Amendment No. 1 to ChEF Purchase Agreement (equity purchase facility)
: Increase equity financing capacity and flexibility
